data.one_liner: A Flutter countdown timer widget providing easy-to-use countdown functionality.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pre-made countdown timer widget called CountDownText that handles formatting due dates into days, hours, minutes, and seconds. It supports custom text labels, styles, and triggers a callback when the target date is reached.
use_when: You need to display a simple countdown timer in a Flutter UI widget.
You want customizable date labels and finish text for a countdown.
avoid_when: You need complex background time tracking or notification features.
You require a complex date parsing or time zone library.
strengths: Simple to implement with a single CountDownText widget.
Supports custom labels for days, hours, minutes, and seconds.
weaknesses: Limited to countdown UI rendering functionality.
Documentation is minimal beyond basic README usage.
data.minimal_example:
CountDownText(
  due: DateTime.parse("2050-01-01 00:00:00"),
  finishedText: "Done",
  showLabel: true,
  longDateName: true,
  style: TextStyle(color: Colors.blue),
)
